description: Backend: append the four Cloud Functions callables and a bootstrap script to functions/ (without touching exports.apply), extend firestore.rules, add firestore.indexes.json, and wire the indexes entry into firebase.json. Independent of the client features (FEAT-001/002) — no client build dependency — but ordered here so the client it serves exists first. Enforces the RBAC and audit invariants at the rules + functions layers.
steps: Edit functions/index.js (APPEND only; do NOT modify the existing exports.apply): add imports { onCall, HttpsError } from 'firebase-functions/v2/https', { getAuth } from 'firebase-admin/auth', and { FieldValue } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'. Add helpers assertAuthed(request) (throws HttpsError('unauthenticated') if !request.auth), and role helpers reading request.auth.token.role: assertSuperadmin(request) (role must be 'superadmin' else permission-denied), assertEditor(request) (admin or superadmin), assertAdmin(request) (any of viewer/admin/superadmin). Never trust a role sent in request.data.

Add exports.setApplicationStatus = onCall({ region: 'europe-west1' }, async (request) => {...}): assertEditor; validate request.data.appId is a non-empty string <=1500 chars and request.data.status is one of new|contacted|interview|accepted|rejected (else HttpsError('invalid-argument')); run a Firestore transaction that reads applications/{appId} (HttpsError('not-found') if missing), updates status, and appends applications/{appId}/history/{autoId} = { actorUid: request.auth.uid, actorEmail: request.auth.token.email||'', field:'status', from: <old>, to: <new>, at: FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }; return { ok:true, status }. Wrap unexpected errors as HttpsError('internal') and console.error them.
Add exports.listAdmins = onCall({ region:'europe-west1' }, ...): assertSuperadmin; return the admins collection docs where revoked != true (uid, email, role, grantedByEmail, grantedAt, updatedAt).

Add exports.grantRole = onCall({ region:'europe-west1' }, ...): assertSuperadmin; validate request.data.role in {superadmin,admin,viewer} and request.data.email matches an email regex (trim+lowercase); getAuth().getUserByEmail(email) -> HttpsError('not-found','המשתמש לא קיים במערכת ההזדהות') if absent; self-guard: a superadmin cannot change their own role; setCustomUserClaims(uid,{ role }) (replaces the whole claims object — role is the only claim); THEN upsert admins/{uid} with { uid, email, role, grantedBy: request.auth.uid, grantedByEmail: request.auth.token.email||'', grantedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp() (only on create) , updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), revoked: false } (revoked MUST be set explicitly); return { ok:true, uid, role }.

Add exports.revokeAdmin = onCall({ region:'europe-west1' }, ...): assertSuperadmin; validate request.data.uid non-empty string; self-guard (cannot revoke self); last-superadmin guard: query collection('admins').where('role','==','superadmin').where('revoked','==',false) and if the target is the only match throw HttpsError('failed-precondition','לא ניתן להסיר את מנהל העל האחרון'); setCustomUserClaims(uid,{ role: null }); update admins/{uid} { revoked: true, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() } (soft delete); return { ok:true }.

Create functions/scripts/bootstrap-admins.js: standalone firebase-admin script using Application Default Credentials (initializeApp() with no args). Hardcode seed emails ['asaf@sb0.tech','mor.k@elevation.ac']; for each getUserByEmail, setCustomUserClaims(uid,{role:'superadmin'}), and upsert admins/{uid} with revoked:false and grantedByEmail:'bootstrap' (merge). Idempotent (re-asserts the same claim + revoked:false). Print a summary line per email and exit. Add a header comment with the run command (node scripts/bootstrap-admins.js from functions/, after gcloud auth application-default login or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS).

Edit firestore.rules: keep rules_version='2' and the service/match structure; add functions role() { return request.auth != null ? request.auth.token.role : null; } and isAdmin() { return role() in ['viewer','admin','superadmin']; }. Under match /applications/{doc}: COPY the existing public create block VERBATIM; change the second line to 'allow read: if isAdmin();' and 'allow update, delete: if false;'; add a nested match /history/{entry} { allow read: if isAdmin(); allow write: if false; }. Add match /admins/{uid} { allow read: if isAdmin(); allow write: if false; }. Keep the default-deny match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if false; }.

Create firestore.indexes.json declaring one composite index on collection 'applications' with fields status (ASCENDING) and createdAt (DESCENDING), and an empty fieldOverrides array, in the standard Firebase indexes schema { "indexes": [...], "fieldOverrides": [] }.

Edit firebase.json: in the 'firestore' block (currently { "rules": "firestore.rules" }) add "indexes": "firestore.indexes.json" so it becomes { "rules": "firestore.rules", "indexes": "firestore.indexes.json" }. Leave hosting and functions blocks unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: exports.apply in functions/index.js is byte-for-byte unchanged.
cd functions && node -c index.js and node -c scripts/bootstrap-admins.js both report no syntax errors.
require('./index.js') from functions/ loads without throwing (admin SDK init is lazy).
firestore.rules preserves the public applications create block verbatim and closes update/delete to clients; admins and history are write:false.
firestore.indexes.json is valid JSON with the status ASC + createdAt DESC composite index, and firebase.json firestore block references it.
findings:
Implemented all four callables in functions/index.js (APPEND only; exports.apply byte-for-byte unchanged). All callables region 'europe-west1', role authority from request.auth.token.role only (never request.data).

Client wiring notes for later FEATs (src/lib/adminApi.ts):
- setApplicationStatus(request.data: { appId: string<=1500, status: new|contacted|interview|accepted|rejected }) -> { ok:true, status }. Errors: invalid-argument, not-found, permission-denied (needs admin|superadmin), internal.
- listAdmins() -> { admins: [{ uid, email, role, grantedByEmail, grantedAt, updatedAt }] } (non-revoked only). Requires superadmin.
- grantRole(request.data: { email, role: superadmin|admin|viewer }) -> { ok:true, uid, role }. email trimmed+lowercased server-side. Errors: not-found ('המשתמש לא קיים במערכת ההזדהות'), failed-precondition (self-role-change blocked), invalid-argument. Requires superadmin. setCustomUserClaims replaces whole claims object (role is only claim) so claim refresh needed client-side (getIdToken(true)).
- revokeAdmin(request.data: { uid }) -> { ok:true }. Errors: failed-precondition ('לא ניתן להסיר את מנהל העל האחרון' last-superadmin, and self-revoke blocked). Soft delete: sets admins/{uid}.revoked=true and clears claim (role:null). Requires superadmin.

audit history: applications/{appId}/history/{autoId} = { actorUid, actorEmail, field:'status', from, to, at:serverTimestamp }. 'at' is a Firestore Timestamp — client must convert via ts?.toDate().toISOString() before passing to formatDateTimeHe (design finding 10).

firestore.rules: public applications create block preserved verbatim; read now gated on isAdmin() (role in viewer/admin/superadmin); update/delete:false for clients (status mutated only via setApplicationStatus callable with admin privileges); history read:isAdmin, write:false; admins read:isAdmin, write:false; default deny retained.

firestore.indexes.json: composite index applications (status ASC, createdAt DESC) — supports the ApplicationsPage status filter + createdAt desc ordering. firebase.json firestore block now references it.

Bootstrap: functions/scripts/bootstrap-admins.js seeds asaf@sb0.tech + mor.k@elevation.ac as superadmin via ADC; idempotent; run 'node scripts/bootstrap-admins.js' from functions/ after ADC login. Seed accounts must pre-exist in Firebase Auth.

Verification (all passed): node -c index.js; node -c scripts/bootstrap-admins.js; require('./index.js') loads; JSON.parse of firestore.indexes.json + firebase.json OK.
